features.text: Patient reports struggling with depression more due to being trapped inside and working remotely over the past year.
Patient mentions experiencing stiffness and pain when sitting for long periods at work.
Patient describes a sensation of numbing in the legs, but no tingling or pain.
Patient reports the numbing sensation is similar to a limb falling asleep.
Patient states the symptoms bother them when standing or sitting for extended periods.
Patient has a history of congenital artery issue and underwent CABG surgery at a young age.
Patient is currently taking medication for depression and believes increasing the dose may help.
Patient prefers to start with physical therapy for chronic back pain.
